lines.en: Mom, are you ready for morning stretching?
Yes. My legs feel heavy this morning.
Let's bend slowly and count to ten.
That feels good. Is my body more flexible now?
lines.ko: 좋네요. 제 몸이 이제 더 유연해요?

lines.en: Yes, much better. Did you jog last week?
Yes, I jogged with Grandpa twice last week.
lines.ko: 네, 지난주에 할아버지랑 두 번 조깅했어요.

lines.en: Wonderful. Your muscle strength is growing.
Thank you. Should I jump too?
No jumping. Walking gives you enough energy.
lines.ko: 뛰는 건 안 하셔도 돼요. 걷기만 해도 기운이 충분해요.

lines.en: Okay. I will walk to the gym tomorrow.
Welcome. Today we will do easy stretching.
lines.ko: 어서 오세요. 오늘은 쉬운 스트레칭을 할 거예요.

lines.en: Good morning. My legs are weak. Is that okay?
Don't worry. Can you bend your arms slowly?
lines.ko: 걱정 마세요. 팔을 천천히 구부릴 수 있어요?

lines.en: Yes, like this. Is that right?
That's right. Now squat a little, please.
lines.ko: 맞아요. 이제 조금만 쪼그려 앉아 보세요.

lines.en: Oh, my muscle feels warm. That's nice.
Good. Did you jog here this morning?
No, I walked slowly this morning.
Fine. Walking builds strength and gives energy.
lines.ko: 좋아요. 걷기가 힘을 키우고 기운을 줘요.

lines.en: Thank you. I'm going to come every Monday.
